title: Contrastive Canary Guard with Adaptive Hysteresis and Contextual Thresholds
creator: Ariana Patel
description: Implement a new canary evaluation guard that uses contrastive signal (delta vs baseline) plus contextual thresholds per traffic cohort to trigger automatic partial and full rollbacks. This ticket scopes the runtime controller, metric selection, threshold calibration, and the rollback orchestration glue. Goals: reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks in noisy low-volume cohorts, catch semantic regressions (hallucination, refusal, relevance) and enable safe automated remediations with explainable provenance for postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: Canary controller computes per-cohort delta metrics between candidate and baseline for at least three metric families: semantic-accuracy (eval win-rate), hallucination proxy (fact-consistency score), and latency/p99 impact
Adaptive thresholds calculated from historical traffic windows and synthetic probe baselines; thresholds expose a tunable hysteresis window to prevent churn
Rollback policies implemented: partial-weight reduction (e.g., -50%), cohort freeze, and full revert; each action emits an auditable event with metric snapshot and root-cause tags
End-to-end test harness: simulated cohorts with injected regressions produce expected rollback actions in CI against shadow and canary clusters
Console dashboard surfaces: per-canary metric deltas, decision rationale, and linkable playbooks for on-call
tasks: Design metric schema and provenance tags (owner: Marco)

comments: 2026-01-20 Ariana Patel: RFC posted — proposing contrastive approach instead of absolute thresholds to reduce spurious rollbacks for small cohorts.
2026-01-25 Marco Chen: Design sync notes — decided on three primary metric families; agreed to include synthetic adversarial probes to raise signal for low-traffic cohorts.
2026-02-02 ML-evals: Prototype compared KL-divergence vs win-rate delta; win-rate on curated prompt bank proved more interpretable for PMs; KL kept as auxiliary metric.
2026-02-15 Infra-team: Delta computation service proto implemented; concerns about upstream KV cache pressure when sampling full token streams — added sampling adaptor to reduce payloads.
2026-02-23 SRE: Hysteresis window proposal — use time-and-count based gating (min samples + 10-minute stabilization) to avoid flip-flopping under traffic spikes.

2026-03-01 QA: E2E harness sim shows correct partial rollback at 40% traffic when semantic-accuracy delta > threshold for 3 consecutive windows; edge-case: very bursty traffic still produced noisy signal — added smoothing.
2026-03-07 PM review: Can we expose the threshold sliders in Console per release? Decided to expose 'sensitivity' presets (conservative / balanced / agressive) and surface recommended values.
2026-03-09 Security: security review requested for event provenance and audit logs — pending KMS integration verification.
2026-03-10 Marco Chen: Started implementation of the controller state machine; opened initial PR and linked tests.
